manifesto.line2: Or one that does it all.
manifesto.body: Most companies buy their future in pieces. A brand from one place. A website from another. Software from a third. And an AI tool nobody opens. Four invoices, four roadmaps, and nothing that fits together.
manifesto.close: We build the whole thing. Because the whole thing is the point.

founder.body: Breadegg is run by Gil. Every request is designed and built by the same person who answers your messages: no account managers, no handoffs. That's why there are only 4 seats. Trusted freelancers help with translation and testing when a job needs it.

items.q: What do I get with the subscription?
items.a: A product team for one flat monthly price: design, websites, app screens, SEO and AI automations. You add requests to your board and they're delivered one at a time.

Anything that fits in about a day of work: a page, a landing page, a set of ads, an email, an app screen, a simple integration. Bigger jobs, like a full website, are split into requests and delivered in parts.

items.q: How fast will I get my requests?
items.a: About 3 business days per request, on average. Bigger requests arrive in parts, one every few days, until they're done.

items.q: Is there a limit to how many requests I can make?
items.a: No. Add as many as you like; they're delivered one at a time, in the order you choose.
Billing runs in 31-day cycles. If you pause after 21 days, the other 10 are kept for you for up to 6 months, to use whenever you come back.
Native apps and large AI builds, which get a fixed price as projects. We also don't do video, 3D or complex print work.

items.q: What if I don't like what I get?
items.a: We keep revising it until it's right.
In the first week, if it isn't for you, 75% comes back. After that, delivered work isn't refunded, but you can cancel at any time.
You do. Code, designs and accounts are in your name from day one, and you don't need the subscription to keep them.

items.q: Where are you, and do you work with my country?
items.a: Remotely, from Portugal, with clients anywhere. Our hours overlap with all of Europe and the US East Coast, and we work in English, Portuguese, Spanish and German.
On your own board. Write a brief, share a doc or a design, or record a short Loom video if you'd rather talk it through.

faq.q: How long does a website take?
faq.a: A landing page usually takes a few days. A full website is split into requests and arrives in parts, typically over 2 to 4 weeks.

faq.q: How much does a website cost?
faq.a: It's included in the subscription: one flat monthly price, with no separate quote. You can pause or cancel at any time.

faq.q: Can you work with the brand I already have?
faq.a: Yes. If you already have a logo and colours, we build on them. If not, we design the brand first.

faq.q: Will my website show up on Google?
faq.a: Every website includes the SEO basics: speed, structure, metadata and structured data, so Google and AI assistants can read it. To go further, see SEO and AI search.

faq.a: The logo and its versions, colours, type, a short guide on how to use them and every file you need for web, app, print and social media.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: It depends on the scope. In the subscription it arrives a request at a time, usually within 2 to 4 weeks for a full identity.

faq.q: Can you also build the website or the app?
faq.a: Yes. That is the idea behind Breadegg: the brand, the website and the app made as one thing, by the same team.

faq.q: Who owns the brand?

faq.q: What is GEO?
faq.a: Generative Engine Optimisation: making your business appear in the answers of AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini, the way SEO does for Google.

faq.q: Are SEO and GEO different?
faq.a: They share the basics: a fast, well-structured site with clear content. GEO adds what AI assistants read: structured data, direct answers to real questions and an llms.txt file.

faq.q: How long until I see results?
faq.a: The technical work takes weeks. Rankings and mentions in AI answers take longer, usually months, and depend on your market. We tell you what to expect before we start.

faq.q: Do you guarantee first place on Google?
faq.a: No. Nobody honest can. We guarantee the work in writing and show you what changed.
